name: OpenWrt Network Health & Alerts v0.2.7
description: RPC, WAN, ping loss, weak Wi-Fi and syslog status
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Group justify="flex-end"><RefreshButton requestId="health" size="xs" /></Group>{status.health?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red">API request failed. Check source and bearer token.</Alert> : null}<Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>Network Health & Alerts</Text><Badge color={data.health?.status === "critical" ? "red" : data.health?.status === "warning" ? "yellow" : "green"}>{data.health?.status ?? "loading"}</Badge></Group><SimpleGrid cols={2}><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">OpenWrt RPC</Text><Text fw={700}>{data.health?.rpcAvailable ? "ONLINE" : "UNAVAILABLE"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">WAN</Text><Text fw={700}>{data.health?.wanUp === true ? "UP" : data.health?.wanUp === false ? "DOWN" : "UNKNOWN"}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Weak Wi-Fi clients</Text><Text fw={700}>{data.health?.weakWifiClients?.length ?? 0}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Alert count</Text><Text fw={700}>{data.health?.alertCount ?? 0}</Text></Paper></SimpleGrid><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Last syslog timestamp: {data.health?.lastSyslogAt ?? "none"} (Unix seconds)</Text><Text fw={600}>Alerts</Text>{data.health?.alerts?.length ? <Text size="sm">{data.health.alerts[0]?.severity}: {data.health.alerts[0]?.message}</Text> : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No current alerts</Text>}{data.health?.alerts?.length > 1 ? <Text size="sm">{data.health.alerts[1]?.severity}: {data.health.alerts[1]?.message}</Text> : null}{data.health?.alerts?.length > 2 ? <Text size="sm">{data.health.alerts[2]?.severity}: {data.health.alerts[2]?.message}</Text> : null}{data.health?.alerts?.length > 3 ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Additional alerts available from /network/health</Text> : null}<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Ping measured from TrueNAS; syslog silence is informational only.</Text></Stack>
